title: Going deeper: Read the body before the story
categoryContext: Growing independence at home, school and online
stageSummary: Notice adult pressure, observable cues and the sentence that is about to leave the mouth.
possibleWeather: Older children may hear pressure as mistrust, public judgement or loss of agency. Make the reason, choice and responsibility visible.
boundary: The adult can keep everyone safe.
practice: check what the child's body may be communicating
principle: Use observable cues without diagnosing or mind-reading.
nextSentence: The adult can keep everyone safe. Tell me what is getting in the way, then we can check what the child's body may be communicating.
keyLearning: Use observable cues without diagnosing or mind-reading.
